user.description: Choose a Week Aqua device in Bluetooth range.

disclaimer.title: Use at your own risk
disclaimer.description:
This is an unofficial, community-made integration. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by the manufacturer of Week Aqua products. It controls your devices with a reverse-engineered protocol, which may contain errors.

It is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind (see the MIT license). The authors are not liable for any damage to your devices, aquarium, livestock or property, including damage caused by lights, pumps or schedules not behaving as expected. Always keep an eye on your tank's life support.

You are asked this only once, when adding your first device.

data.risk_accepted: I understand and use this integration at my own risk

abort.no_devices_found: No supported Week Aqua devices found in range. Close the Week Aqua phone app (it holds the connection) and make sure a Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy is near the tank.
abort.not_supported: This Week Aqua model is not supported yet.

error.must_accept: You need to accept the disclaimer to use this integration.

set_schedule.name: Set built-in schedule
set_schedule.description: Program and enable the lamp's own daily on/off window. It runs even when Home Assistant is offline. Same as the Built-in schedule switch and its time and length settings.

clear_schedule.name: Clear built-in schedule
clear_schedule.description: Turn off the lamp's built-in schedule (window 00:00-24:00) so only Home Assistant switches it.
